title: The Healer's Ledger
offer: Agent — you found the leak in Odile's drawers. Now look at mine: one ledger, names and payments and ailments all in the same book, and a merchant from the east keeps offering coin for it.
opener: HERALD — Not all personal data is equal, Ranger. What ails a villager is a different, more dangerous kind than what they paid — sort her book, then lock what must be locked.
debrief: Special category data demands separation and stronger protection. Proportion, not paranoia.
nextHint: Talk to Maren in the Tavern

steps.objective: Sort Maren's ledger by talking to her (press E)
Lock the sensitive records and set access control by talking to Maren
